name: Serverless Fraud Detection Platform

resources.name: Transactions API
resources.purpose: HTTP API with two routes: POST /transactions for ingestion and GET /flagged for querying flagged transactions with explanations

resources.name: Transaction Ingest
resources.purpose: Validates incoming transaction payload (card, amount, merchant, location, timestamp), assigns a transaction ID, and sends it to the processing queue

resources.name: Processing Queue
resources.purpose: Decouples ingestion from scoring, provides back-pressure and retry semantics with a 3-retry redrive policy to the DLQ

resources.name: Dead Letter Queue
resources.purpose: Captures messages that fail scoring 3 times for manual investigation; triggers a CloudWatch alarm when non-empty

resources.name: Fraud Scoring Engine
resources.purpose: Runs rule-based checks (amount threshold, velocity per card in 1h window, geo-impossible travel) then scores with an Isolation Forest model packaged as a Lambda layer. Writes raw+scored data to S3, flagged transactions to DynamoDB, high-risk alerts to SNS, and async-invokes the explainer for flagged items

resources.name: Transactions Data Lake
resources.purpose: Stores all transaction data partitioned by date (year/month/day) in Parquet format for efficient Athena queries. Separate prefixes for raw/ and scored/ data. Encryption at rest with SSE-S3, versioning disabled to save cost, lifecycle policy to move to Glacier after 90 days

resources.name: Flagged Transactions Table
resources.purpose: Stores flagged transactions with attributes: transactionId (PK), timestamp (SK), riskScore, rulesFired, mlScore, explanation, merchantId, region. GSI on riskScore for high-risk queries. On-demand billing, encryption at rest, point-in-time recovery enabled

resources.name: Fraud Alerts Topic
resources.purpose: Publishes high-risk transaction alerts (riskScore > 0.85) to email subscribers. Message includes transaction ID, amount, merchant, risk score, and rules fired

resources.name: Bedrock Explainer
resources.purpose: Invoked asynchronously for flagged transactions. Calls Bedrock Claude 3 Haiku with the transaction context and scoring details to generate a plain-English fraud explanation. Enforces a monthly call cap via a DynamoDB counter. Updates the flagged table with the explanation

resources.name: Query Flagged Transactions
resources.purpose: Handles GET /flagged endpoint with optional query parameters (minRiskScore, startDate, endDate, merchantId). Returns paginated flagged transactions with their Bedrock explanations from DynamoDB

resources.name: Amazon Bedrock (Claude 3 Haiku)
resources.purpose: Foundation model for generating plain-English fraud explanations. Capped at 1,000 calls/month (~$0.38/month). Prompt includes transaction details, risk score, rules fired, and ML anomaly score

resources.name: AWS Glue Data Catalog
resources.purpose: Defines database and table schema over the S3 data lake, enabling Athena to query Parquet data without ETL. Table defined in CloudFormation (no crawler cost)

resources.name: Amazon Athena
resources.purpose: Ad-hoc SQL analytics on fraud patterns: fraud rate by hour, top flagged merchants, geographic hot spots, risk score distributions. Uses Parquet columnar format to minimize data scanned (~$0.001/month)

resources.name: Monitoring Dashboard & Alarms
resources.purpose: Dashboard showing fraud rate, scoring latency, error rates, DLQ depth, API latency, and Bedrock call count. 6 alarms: scoring-errors, api-5xx, dlq-not-empty, scoring-p99-latency, lambda-throttles, monthly-cost-anomaly. 4 custom metrics: fraud-rate, avg-risk-score, flagged-count, explanation-latency

summary: A serverless, event-driven fraud detection platform that scores card transactions in near real-time using rule-based checks and an Isolation Forest ML model on Lambda. Transactions flow through an HTTP API to an SQS-decoupled scoring pipeline. Flagged transactions are stored in DynamoDB with AI-generated explanations from Amazon Bedrock, and high-risk alerts go via SNS. All raw and scored data lands in S3 in Parquet format, queryable through Glue Data Catalog and Athena for fraud pattern analytics. CloudWatch provides dashboards and alarms across all components.
